periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, approximately 50 degrees relative to the horizontal craniofacial axis, sloping anterior-inferiorly towards the snout.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Pronounced oval geometry with an estimated 2:1 length-to-width ratio.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward taper; the inferior boundary extends notably further from the centroid than the superior boundary.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior margin with a smooth transition into the white dorsal fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering approximately one-third of the visible longitudinal torso area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Clear separation between pinnae; the inter-ear gap is approximately 1.5 times the width of the visible ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, high-radius curvature at the apex, forming a consistent semicircular profile.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown-pigmented staining on the lower abdominal and hindquarter pelage, contrasting with the white dorsal fur.
